description: Publishes a webinar or takes it offline again. Take it when the registration page should go live or should stop taking people. A host says: "Take the page down, the date is gone." It needs the session, the webinar and the status, publish or draft. A clear yes from the host is needed before it runs. On publish the registration page and the room are public and can be found. On draft participants see nothing and registrations stop. It writes on your site; nothing else on the campaign changes and no page is rebuilt. The answer tells you the status that really stands, published or draft, not the one you asked for. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: publish the webinar, take the page down, go live with sign-ups

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said yes to this status.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

status.description: publish makes the webinar public, draft takes it offline.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_webinar_visibility
title: Publish or unpublish a webinar
